reason: A read-only project analysis plugin that scans project directories, identifies modules and dependencies, and presents architecture knowledge graphs through a visual panel and agent-accessible tool.

summaries.zh: 只读扫描项目目录并解析模块与依赖关系，以可视化知识图谱帮助用户理解项目架构。
summaries.en: A read-only project analysis plugin that maps modules and dependencies into visual knowledge graphs for understanding project architecture.

capabilities: Read-only scanning of user-specified project directories
Manifest and dependency analysis across multiple programming languages
Generation of module-level and file-level architecture graphs
Display of graph results in a browser panel
Exposure of graph data through the project_kgraph tool
